methods.name: onLanguageChanged
methods.args_returns: in: handler(lang); out: unsubscribe. Shell Home language switch broadcast

methods.name: onMenuCommand

methods.args_returns: in: handler(command: MenuCommand, payload?); out: unsubscribe. Native app-menu commands (new/open/save/zoom/print/export/...) forwarded to renderer
methods.reason: Native application menu does not exist on the web; the same actions are reachable from the ribbon/keyboard, so the subscription is a no-op stub.

methods.name: onOpenDocx

methods.name: onTeardown
methods.args_returns: in: handler(); out: unsubscribe. Tab closed but webContents kept alive (shell freeze workaround) so renderer stops timers
methods.reason: Workaround for the shell keeping closed tabs alive; browser tab close/unmount handles it.

methods.name: onThemeChanged
methods.args_returns: in: handler(theme: UiTheme); out: unsubscribe. Shell theme switch broadcast
methods.reason: Theme is data-theme + prefers-color-scheme + localStorage in the browser; no host push needed.

methods.name: onZoteroRequest

methods.reason: Zotero word-processor integration is a local TCP wire to the desktop Zotero app; no web equivalent.

methods.name: openDocx

methods.reason: Open flow becomes a UniWork document list/fetch endpoint (returning bytes + hash); a plain <input type=file> can supplement it for local import.

methods.name: openDocxDecrypt

methods.reason: Document-password (encrypted docx) support is desktop-only per the lane scope; server would need ms-offcrypto, so hide for the spike.

methods.name: openDocxPath

methods.name: openNewTab

methods.name: pickImage
methods.args_returns: in: none; out: PickImageResult {base64,mime,name} | null (png/jpg/jpeg/gif, read synchronously from disk)
methods.reason: Plain <input type=file accept=image/*> + FileReader gives the same base64/mime/name.

methods.reason: Local crash-recovery file under userData; web equivalent is IndexedDB/autosave draft, not a bridge call.

methods.reason: Drives the desktop Zotero app over its local wire protocol; no web equivalent.
